notes.title: Pre-order Dragon's Dogma 2 now ahead of its release on March 22nd, 2024!
notes.notes:
Dragon's Dogma 2 is coming on March 22nd, 2024! A new trailer has just been released alongside this news, so check it out. 
Dragon's Dogma 2 main trailer
[previewyoutube=8dt1S_QUBYw;full][/previewyoutube]
Pre-orders are now open for both the standard edition of the game and the Deluxe Edition, which includes the "A Boon for Adventurers - New Journey Pack" DLC. All pre-orders will receive the bonus Superior Weapons Quartet, and pre-ordering the Deluxe Edition grants a further bonus, the Ring of Assurance.
https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/44225443/f1bd81ad6b2c6319f98a586fcf1ae77d87ca991c.jpg
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2054970/Dragons_Dogma_2/

If you haven't played the previous game, Dragon's Dogma: Dark Arisen is on sale for a limited time! Don't miss out on this chance to experience the origins of the series!

notes.title: Dragon's Dogma: Dark Arisen Minor Patch Now Available [12/18/17]
notes.notes:
They're masterworks all, you can't go wrong. 

A new, minor patch has been released today for Dragon's Dogma: Dark Arisen that addresses the following:

【Japanese input error fix】
When typing in Japanese text while in full screen mode, users were not able to see before they converted to kanji, katakana, etc. This has been fixed.

【Ability Bug Fix - Inflection】
Fixed a bug on the ability, “Inflection” in which it was originally doubling damage instead of halving damage in certain situations. Inflection now appropriately halves damage.

【Quest Bug fix】
A rare bug originally occurred in which the quest "Trappings of Evil" was made unavailable if a user upgraded and equipped specific gear. This fix will now allow players who own the upgraded version of that gear to take on the quest.

Best Regards,

CAPCOM USA Customer Support

notes.title: DD:DA Patch #1 Now Available
notes.notes:
Patch #1 Release Notes

Added 1366x768 resolution support
Game should no longer have intermittent controller device detection issues when multiple devices are plugged in.  This should address some of the stutter and input issues reported by users including spell/charge attacks not releasing, character ceasing to run etc. 
Lantern binding issue - When full lantern becomes half-full, it will still be bound to the hotkey. (previously "half full" and "empty" were treated as separate inventory items)
Cursed King's Belt  - equipping this item on a male character will no longer crash the game
Adjusted audio levels – addressed the ‘audio too low’ issue some users encountered
VSync set to OFF by default
DirectInput controller adjustments:

Deadzone for each pad is now stored and configurable via config.ini
DualShock 4 on PC will now have the same deadzone sensitivity as on PS4
Other DirectInput gamepads will also have a much tighter deadzone as well (the same accuracy/sensitivity as on X360 gamepad)

Game logo in Photo Mode – removed artifact on the right edge of the logo watermark. 
Refresh rate settings – the game will now properly detect the refresh rate set in config.ini
Key bindings – mapped “0” as the 'center camera' button.
End game credits crashing the game for some users – while this issue could not be reproduced, some changes have been made which should help reduce or eliminate the issue.


Note: the team is still looking into the 5.1/7.1 audio popping/crackling issue that some users have reported.  Please stay tuned for a future update.
